name: M7.RecipeSignature.tau_degree
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) → (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F).natDegree = F.natDegree
guidance: Instantiate accepted QuotientDegree.degree_invariant N F (tau u F) with concrete SignatureTau.equiv u, tau_properties and tau_principal.symm. The RingEquiv.toRingHom is definitionally actual substitution u. Reverse the resulting equality. No new quotient-cardinality proof. Return tactic lines without leading by.
